title: 2011 Prairie's corner turret gets its two-stage slate roof
items: The round turret at 2011 Prairie Avenue now has the roof its photograph shows: a flared slate skirt, then a ledge, then a steeper cone up to the finial. Before, it had one plain cone.

The turret now stands about 1.2 m out from the front, as the 1911 map draws it. Before, it stood 2.15 m out. From the south, the arched front door and the window over it now show beside the turret, as they do in the 1895 Inland Architect photograph.
